h1.en: Reading Diesel 120 vs Electric 80 Pumping Distance with a picture from Circuit breaker
h1.zh: 读柴油120和电动80的输送距离如何对照，配图来自「斷路器」

directAnswer.en: Electric 80 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai with different distance pairs. Electric 80 lists pumping distance (H / V) as 900 m / 300 m, with 60 m³/h and a 110 kW motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker.
directAnswer.zh: 电动80和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，距离组不同。电动80的输送距离（水平/垂直）为 900 m / 300 m，产量 60 m³/h，电机 110 kW。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker. Subject: Jtecul. Electric 80 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai with different distance pairs. Theoretical output: Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h. Dimensions: Diesel 120 lists 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Electric 80 lists 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Read the H / V label before comparing 900 m with 500 m. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker。画面主体：Jtecul。电动80和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，距离组不同。料斗容积：柴油120标出 0.6 m³；电动80标出 0.7 m³。整机重量：柴油120标出 8000 kg；电动80标出 6000 kg。电动80有、柴油120没有的行：型号行 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110；电机功率 110 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 900 m / 300 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Electric 80 lists pumping distance (H / V) as 900 m / 300 m, with 60 m³/h and a 110 kW motor. Hopper capacity: Diesel 120 lists 0.6 m³. Electric 80 lists 0.7 m³. Main unit weight: Diesel 120 lists 8000 kg. Electric 80 lists 6000 kg. Diesel 120 lists entries that Electric 80 does not: Diesel engine power 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. They sit in different positions in the pair. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电动80的输送距离（水平/垂直）为 900 m / 300 m，产量 60 m³/h，电机 110 kW。液压泵：柴油120标出 Kawasaki 112 (two units)；电动80标出 Kawasaki 140 double pump。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 40 MPa。比较 900 m 和 500 m 之前先看水平/垂直标题。

body.en: Diesel 120 lists conveying distance (H / V) as 150 m / 500 m, with 100 m³/h and 290 kW from two 145 kW units. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 120 lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). Electric 80 lists Kawasaki 140 double pump. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 40 MPa on both pages. Electric 80 lists entries that Diesel 120 does not: Model line Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. Motor power 110 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m. Open /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120 and /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ for Electric 80.
body.zh: 柴油120的输送距离（水平/垂直）为 150 m / 500 m，产量 100 m³/h，动力 290 kW（两台 145 kW）。最大骨料粒径：柴油120标出 6 cm and below；电动80标出 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/，看电动80请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/。

body.en: A longer horizontal entry on one page is not the vertical entry on the other. Max. aggregate size: Diesel 120 lists 6 cm and below. Electric 80 lists 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油120标出 100 m³/h；电动80标出 60 m³/h。外形尺寸：柴油120标出 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm；电动80标出 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。柴油120有、电动80没有的行：柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW)；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list the same theoretical output as Electric 80?
question.zh: 柴油120和电动80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120标出 100 m³/h。电动80标出 60 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list the same hopper capacity as Electric 80?
question.zh: 柴油120和电动80的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 lists 0.6 m³. Electric 80 lists 0.7 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120标出 0.6 m³。电动80标出 0.7 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list the same hydraulic pump as Electric 80?
question.zh: 柴油120和电动80的液压泵一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). Electric 80 lists Kawasaki 140 double pump. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120标出 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。电动80标出 Kawasaki 140 double pump。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is diesel engine power missing on Electric 80?
question.zh: 为什么电动80没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The Electric 80 page does not list that label. Diesel 120 lists 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker.
answer.zh: 电动80这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油120标出的是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_breaker画面里印出的数字。
